criteria.name: Clear
criteria.comment: Short statements in plain words, but taking a tool out "for good" [S5, Q3.2] is never defined, so readers may take it to mean sold, binned or retired. Suggestion: say in one statement what happens to a tool taken out for good, such as it leaves the list of tools.

criteria.name: Complete
criteria.comment: A loan starts and has a week limit [S3, Q2.3], but nothing says how a tool comes back or what happens when the week runs out, so a builder cannot finish the borrowing flow. Suggestion: ask the members how a member returns a tool and what happens to a late one, and add both as statements.

criteria.name: Verifiable
criteria.comment: Most statements can be checked, but the one saying the shed screen shows who has each tool is [no source], so nobody has confirmed it is wanted, let alone how fast it must update. Suggestion: confirm or remove it through "Talk to an agent about this PRD" on the PRD view.

criteria.name: Tied to objectives
criteria.comment: The Problem states the loss, 6 of 40 tools [S6, Q4.1], but sets no goal, so no statement can be checked against an outcome. Suggestion: decide a target such as at most one missing tool at the next autumn count, and say which flows serve it.

criteria.name: Consistent
criteria.comment: No two statements contradict each other, and the shed keeper's powers agree across Users and roles and Permissions. Suggestion: say "key-card holder" wherever only key-card holders are meant, since Permissions narrows "member" to them.

criteria.name: Feasible
criteria.comment: A key-card reader and one shed screen are ordinary hardware for a community garden, but no statement says the shed has power or a network. Suggestion: confirm with the members that the shed can run a screen and a reader, and add it as a statement.

criteria.name: Needs, not solutions
criteria.comment: The key-card reader [S2, Q2.1] fixes how members borrow before the need behind it is stated, so a cheaper way could never be weighed. Suggestion: state the need first, such as only known members can borrow, and keep the reader as the chosen way to meet it.

criteria.name: Scope and priorities
criteria.comment: Nothing says what the first version must do or what is left out, so a builder cannot tell a must from a nice-to-have. Suggestion: ask the members what is out of scope and which flows the first version needs, and add both as statements.

sections.name: Problem
sections.comment: One decided fact, the loss at the autumn count [S6, Q4.1], but not who it hurts or what outcome the garden wants. Suggestion: add the outcome the garden wants, such as fewer missing tools at the next count.

sections.name: Users and roles
sections.comment: Both roles are decided [S7, Q6.1], but not whether the shed keeper also borrows like any member. Suggestion: ask whether the shed keeper borrows like everyone else, and say so.

sections.name: Flows
sections.comment: Borrowing and the week limit are decided, but one of the three statements is [no source] and returning a tool is missing. Suggestion: confirm the shed screen statement with the members and add the return flow.

sections.name: Permissions
sections.comment: Who may lend and who may take a tool out for good are both decided [S4, Q3.1] [S5, Q3.2]. Suggestion: say who may add a tool to the list or take one off it.
